canonical_example.translation: He likes to collect seashells and put them in a jar.

canonical_example.text: Sus calificaciones no reúnen los requisitos mínimos para entrar al programa.
canonical_example.translation: His grades do not meet the minimum entry requirements for the program.

canonical_example.text: Los solicitantes de la beca deben reunir las condiciones especificadas.
canonical_example.translation: Applicants for the grant must fulfill the specified conditions.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermano y yo vamos a reunirnos en el café al mediodía.
canonical_example.translation: My brother and I are going to meet at the café at noon.

canonical_example.text: Puedes usar mi teléfono viejo si no logras encontrar el tuyo.
canonical_example.translation: You can use my old phone if you don't manage to find yours.

canonical_example.text: Voy a usar mi chaqueta nueva cuando haga frío.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to wear my new jacket when it gets cold.

canonical_example.text: En verano se vuelven a usar los vestidos y las faldas.
canonical_example.translation: In summer, dresses and skirts are worn again.

canonical_example.text: Se usaban los overoles en los ochenta y los noventa.
canonical_example.translation: Overalls were in fashion in the eighties and nineties.

canonical_example.text: La bala lo hirió en el hombro.
canonical_example.translation: The bullet wounded him in the shoulder.

canonical_example.text: Tus palabras hirieron su orgullo.
canonical_example.translation: Your words hurt his pride.

canonical_example.text: Los colores brillantes me hieren la vista.
canonical_example.translation: Bright colors hurt my eyes.

canonical_example.text: La explosión hirió a varias personas, pero a ninguna de gravedad.
canonical_example.translation: The explosion injured several people, but none of them seriously.

canonical_example.text: Dobla las rodillas y hiere la pelota con el palo.
canonical_example.translation: Bend your knees and hit the ball with the club.

canonical_example.text: Hirió la pelota fuerte.
canonical_example.translation: He struck the ball hard.

canonical_example.text: Se hirió la mano cuando estaba cortando la cebolla.
canonical_example.translation: He hurt his hand when he was cutting an onion.

canonical_example.text: Me herí tratando de escapar.
canonical_example.translation: I injured myself trying to escape.
